title: Latent Evolution Operator (LEO): State-to-State Forecasting of Parametric PDEs
abstract: arXiv:2505.09063v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Solving time-dependent parametric partial differential equations (PDEs) with high-fidelity solvers is expensive in multi-query settings. This motivates reduced-order models in latent space. Existing methods are typically either (i) recurrent latent dynamics models, which require step-by-step integration and accumulate error over long horizons, or (ii) neural operators, which enable direct prediction but are usually trained from initial conditions and do not explicitly enforce generalization from intermediate states.   We introduce the Latent Evolution Operator (LEO), a parameterized map that takes a state at an arbitrary time, together with physical parameters and a forecast horizon, and predicts the future state in a single latent-space evaluation. Under standard manifold and regularity assumptions, finite-time evolution operators admit an encoder-propagator-decoder decomposition. We approximate this structure using neural networks

translated_title: 潜在演化算子（LEO）：参数化偏微分方程的状态到状态预测
translated_abstract: 在多查询场景下，使用高保真求解器求解随时间变化的参数化偏微分方程（PDE）代价高昂，这促使人们研究潜在空间中的降阶模型。现有方法通常要么是（i）递归潜在动力学模型，这类模型需要逐步积分并在长时间预测中累积误差；要么是（ii）神经算子，这类模型能够实现直接预测，但通常从初始条件开始训练，并未显式地强制实现从中间状态的泛化能力。我们提出了潜在演化算子，这是一种参数化映射，它接收任意时刻的状态，连同物理参数和预测时间跨度，并在单次潜在空间评估中预测未来状态。在标准的流形和正则性假设下，有限时间演化算子可以分解为编码器-传播器-解码器的结构。我们使用神经网络来近似这一结构。
tldr: 本文提出潜在演化算子（LEO），一种能以任意时刻状态、物理参数和预测时间跨度为输入、在单次潜在空间评估中直接预测参数化偏微分方程未来状态的参数化映射，从而避免了逐步积分带来的误差累积，并实现了从中间状态出发的泛化预测。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the Latent Evolution Operator (LEO), a parameterized map that forecasts the future state of parametric PDEs from any intermediate state, physical parameters, and a forecast horizon in a single latent-space evaluation, avoiding the error accumulation of step-by-step integration while enabling generalization from intermediate states.
